title: Offcut — real human-agent cutting plans with native WebMCP
description:
Offcut is a shared cutting-stock workbench for small workshops and makerspaces. People record usable stock and exact part requirements, protect physical lengths, compare real cutting layouts and release an exact reviewed cut sheet. A browser agent uses six native WebMCP tools on the same live committed workspace.

Live workbench: https://ilyanaxo.github.io/offcut-webmcp/
Public MIT source: https://github.com/ilyanaxo/offcut-webmcp
Use, run and test guide: https://ilyanaxo.github.io/offcut-webmcp/guide.html

This recording uses14 actual model-selected native tool calls on the public Chrome workbench, not a fabricated conversation or a ChatGPT screen recording. The external receipt panel is a separate recording harness, not a chatbot embedded in Offcut. Person-facing UI controls are exercised through browser automation; the tool capability catalogue has no approval operation, but this is not cryptographic proof of human presence. Waiting time is trimmed.

The workshop measurements are an original illustrative example. All alternatives produce14 parts totalling7000mm while A-01 stays protected. With3mm kerf and a400mm reusable-remnant threshold, least-stock/fewest-handling opens7200mm across3 lengths and discards200mm (42mm sawdust +158mm short scrap). Keeping useful offcuts opens10080mm across6 lengths, discards42mm and leaves3038mm of qualifying remnants. These are computed scenario trade-offs, not measured workshop-wide money/carbon/cutting-time savings.

Original English narration synthesized locally with Piper, en_US-ljspeech-high. Voice model: Bryce Beattie; LJ Speech dataset: Keith Ito and Linda Johnson. Creator/dataset public-domain declarations: https://brycebeattie.com/files/tts/ and https://keithito.com/LJ-Speech-Dataset/ . Jurisdiction/rights scope is recorded in submission/media-rights.json; no human narrator endorsement is claimed. Original Offcut visuals, no copied workshop photos or copyrighted music. Captions use Liberation Sans under SIL OFL1.1; output documents are not required to carry the font license.

Offcut is a planning estimate, not machine-control or a safe-cutting guarantee. Verify actual usable lengths, stock identity, kerf and safe workholding at the bench.
